overall_notes: This paper focuses exclusively on the sentence ordering task, which is technically an NLG task (generating coherent text ordering), though it's more of a text structuring/reconstruction task rather than content generation. The paper extensively evaluates using automatic metrics but does not conduct human or LLM-as-judge evaluations. The extraction quality was good but included some items that were only mentioned as applications rather than being the focus of the paper.
